cards.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, is waging war against Judah. So Zedekiah, king of Judah, sends two men to the prophet Jeremiah: Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They've come with a request.

cards.question: With Babylon at war against them, what do Zedekiah's men ask Jeremiah to do?

answers.text: Inquire of the LORD for them
Make peace with Babylon for them
Lead the army out for them

cards.question: Zedekiah's men hope the LORD will do something like His past wonders so Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from them.

cards.text: Zedekiah's men are hoping for a wonder, and I know that feeling: every time my old junk drawer rattled open, I held my breath and thought, THIS is it! Jeremiah answers with a message for Zedekiah from the LORD, the God of Israel.

cards.question: Babylon's people, the Chaldeans, besiege the city from outside the wall, and Zedekiah's people are fighting them. What does the LORD say He will turn against Zedekiah's people?

answers.text: The weapons in their own hands
The walls of their own city
The horses in their own stables

cards.text: And about the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans, the LORD says, "I will assemble their forces in the center of this city."

cards.question: The LORD says He Himself will fight for Zedekiah against Babylon.

cards.text: The LORD says He'll fight against them with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury and great wrath. He will strike down the people of the city, both man and beast, and they will die in a terrible plague.

cards.question: After the plague, the LORD says He will hand Zedekiah, his officers and the survivors over to Nebuchadnezzar. How will Nebuchadnezzar treat them?

answers.text: He will make them his servants
He will send them home to Judah

cards.text: Then the LORD has a message for the people: "Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death." Two roads, friend.

cards.question: With the Chaldeans besieging the city, who does the LORD say will live?
The LORD says He has set His face against the city and will hand it to the king of Babylon, who will destroy it with ___.

cards.text: Next, the LORD has a word for the royal family, the house of David, and it's a job they have to do every morning. Friend, that's a job with an alarm clock and NO snooze button.

cards.question: Every morning, the house of David is told to administer ___ and rescue the victim of robbery from his oppressor.
If the house of David doesn't administer justice every morning and rescue the victim of robbery, the LORD says His wrath will burn like fire with no one to put it out.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He is against the ones who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau. Prime real estate, friend. GREAT view.

cards.question: The LORD says He is against the ones who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau. What do they say about themselves?

answers.text: No one can come against us
The LORD will always protect us
Egypt will come to save us

cards.text: The LORD says He'll punish them as their deeds deserve. He'll kindle a fire in their forest that will consume everything around them.

Now the LORD sends Jeremiah down to the palace of the king of Judah, who sits on David's throne, with a word for the king, his officials and his people. Jeremiah's making a house call, friend, and the house is a PALACE.
The LORD tells the king to administer justice and righteousness, and to rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor. Sound familiar?

cards.question: The LORD also tells the king to do no wrong or violence to certain people. Who are they?

answers.text: Foreigners and the fatherless and widows

cards.text: And one more: "Do not shed innocent blood in this place." Then the LORD gives the king a big IF.

cards.question: If the king carries out the LORD's commands to do justice, rescue the oppressed and not shed innocent blood, kings who sit on David's throne will enter the palace gates riding on chariots and horses.

cards.text: Then comes the other side of that IF. If the king doesn't obey, the LORD says, "…I swear by Myself…"

cards.question: If the king doesn't obey these words, what does the LORD swear this house will become?

cards.text: The LORD tells the king's house, "You are like Gilead to Me, like the summit of Lebanon…" Gilead is a land east of the Jordan, and Lebanon is a land north of Israel.

cards.question: The LORD says He will never turn the king's house into a desert.
The LORD will appoint destroyers, each man with his weapons, who cut down the choicest ___ of the king's house and throw them into the fire.

cards.text: Then the LORD says many nations will pass by the city and ask one another, "Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?"

cards.question: When the nations ask why the LORD did this to the great city, what answer do people give?

answers.text: They forsook the LORD's covenant and served other gods
They ignored the LORD's prophets and trusted in Egypt
They neglected the LORD's temple and stopped His offerings
